facts.fact: A PIDA project prospectus sponsored by the ECCAS Secretariat lists the Central African Republic among 11 countries in a USD 9m project to set up six new data centres (one in the CAR) and reinforce five others, to regionalize intra-ECCAS data exchange, showing 25% progress but project stage 'Project Definition'; the page carries no date of its own, so the published date is used.
